author: Sunzi
title: The Art of War
edition: London: Luzac & Co., 1910; Project Gutenberg eBook #132
public_domain_basis: Lionel Giles died in 1958; the 1910 edition and Project Gutenberg eBook #132 are public domain in the USA. Jurisdiction must be checked before redistribution.
doctrine_profile: Study conditions, choose advantageous ground, avoid waste, and adapt plans to evidence.
anti_drift_boundaries: Apply strategic principles metaphorically and non-violently; never militarize relationships, manipulate people, or fabricate competitive threats.

chunks.text: All warfare is based on deception.

chunks.locator: Chapter III, Attack by Stratagem, section 2
chunks.text: Hence to fight and conquer in all your battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy’s resistance without fighting.
